facts.fact: According to this blog post, Replit's Starter plan is free and includes up to three public apps.
facts.quote: You can also create up to three public apps to share with the world.

facts.fact: According to this blog post, the Replit Core plan costs $20 per month when billed annually.
facts.quote: Priced at $20 per month (billed annually) or $25 per month

facts.fact: According to this blog post, the Replit Core plan costs $25 per month when billed monthly.
facts.quote: Priced at $20 per month (billed annually) or $25 per month

facts.fact: According to this blog post, the Replit Core plan includes $25 in monthly credits for AI usage, deployments, and other cloud services.
facts.quote: It comes with $25 in monthly credits to spend on AI usage, deployments, and other cloud services

facts.fact: According to this blog post, Replit raised Core monthly credits from $10 to $25 in February 2025 without changing the plan price.
facts.quote: Replit bumped those credits up from $10 to $25 in February 2025 without hiking the price.

facts.fact: According to this blog post, the Replit Teams plan costs $40 per user per month.
facts.quote: clocking in at $40 per user per month

facts.fact: According to this blog post, each user on the Replit Teams plan receives $40 in monthly credits.
facts.quote: Each user also gets $40 in monthly credits

facts.fact: According to this blog post, Replit Enterprise pricing is custom and tailored to each organization's requirements.
facts.quote: Pricing here is custom, tailored to your organization’s specific requirements.

facts.fact: According to this blog post, new Replit users receive 10 free Agent checkpoints.
facts.quote: New users get 10 free checkpoints to play with

facts.fact: According to this blog post, the $25 monthly credits on the Replit Core plan cover up to 100 Agent checkpoints per month.
facts.quote: on the Core plan, your $25 credits cover up to 100 checkpoints monthly.

facts.fact: According to this blog post, the Replit Advanced Assistant costs $0.05 per edit request.
According to this blog post, new Replit users receive 20 free Advanced Assistant requests.
facts.quote: New users snag 20 free requests to start

facts.fact: According to this blog post, Replit usage tracking updates may lag by up to 30 minutes.
facts.quote: just note that updates might lag by up to 30 minutes.

facts.fact: According to this blog post, Replit Core users receive 100 GiB of free outbound data transfer per month.
facts.quote: Replit Core users get 100 GiB of free egress monthly.

facts.fact: According to this blog post, Replit Autoscale Deployment overages cost $1 per million Compute Units.
facts.quote: Overages cost $1 per million Compute Units

facts.fact: According to this blog post, a $1 per month base fee for Autoscale Deployments (and Scheduled Deployments) took effect in February 2025.
facts.quote: a new $1/month base fee hit in February 2025 (same goes for Scheduled Deployments).

facts.fact: According to this blog post, each Replit serverless PostgreSQL database has a default storage footprint of 33MB even when empty.
facts.quote: with a 33MB default footprint even if it’s empty.

facts.fact: According to this blog post, Replit PostgreSQL databases are billed for compute time per hour the database is active, which includes any time within 5 minutes of the last request.
facts.quote: Charged per hour your database is active (any request or within 5 minutes of the last one).

facts.fact: According to this blog post, Replit Autoscale Deployments are billed in Compute Units at 2 units per RAM second and 18 units per CPU second.
facts.value: 2 per RAM second; 18 per CPU second
facts.quote: For example, 1 RAM second = 2 units, and 1 CPU second = 18 units.
